name: YF-100
tagline: China's staged-combustion kerolox engine, powering the new generation
description: The YF-100 is the engine that moved China's launch capability into the performance tier that Russia and the United States had occupied for decades. Developed by AALPT in Xi'an, it applies oxygen-rich staged combustion to LOX and RP-1 — the thermodynamic cycle that extracts the most energy from kerosene propellants — and first flew on 20 September 2015. Two YF-100s power the core stage of Long March 5, China's heaviest operational rocket, and clustered variants fly on Long March 6 and Long March 7. The YF-100 underpins China's lunar program, its space station resupply, and its growing commercial launch cadence.
best_known_for: China's modern staged-combustion kerolox engine — Long March 5/6/7
